svg.title: herdr-workflows in five chapters
svg.desc: An animated walkthrough: the commands you retype every time, the YAML that replaces them, picking it with prefix+k, watching it run across herdr panes, and sharing it with the team.

g.text: CHAPTER ONE — WHAT YOU DO TODAY
paste the diff… "review this, blocking issues only"
The work is identical every time — so stop typing it every time.
CHAPTER TWO — WRITE IT DOWN ONCE
Four things a step can do:
a real agent turn, in a real pane
a child workflow, its own inputs
One file. Reviewed like code, committed like code, shared like code.
The picker collects the inputs, then hands off to the runner. Nothing runs from the browser.
lazygit — opened in a new tab
Steps run in order. Each result is there for the next one.
Panes, tabs and notifications stay herdr's job — the workflow just asks.
CHAPTER FIVE — HAND IT TO THE HERD
Build it in the workbench. Send it as one line.
import prints the YAML and asks before writing
